overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator; collapsed into one overload. Also fixed direction: urlText/urlAddress default to 'in' in the mechanical draft, but the doc's arrow column marks both '<-' (out) since the command returns the found URL's label/address into them.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the visible label and address of the first URL found in a text selection of the designated styled-text object; empty strings are returned if no URL is present.
